integration_decision.new_source_supported_gap: Distinct from the known P0 three-output mixed-generation race: storage.append_observations loads existing IDs and semantic signatures, then appends JSONL without a process-wide lock or atomic admission. Two processes reading an empty archive can each append the same observation_id. This is a cross-process archive deduplication time-of-check/time-of-use (TOCTOU) risk; source evidence only, NOT executed or claimed reproduced.
integration_decision.deterministic_no_network_p1_contract: Use multiprocessing spawn with two workers, shared tmp_path/observations.jsonl and one identical FlowObservation fixture; synchronize both before calling storage.append_observations. Unchanged-code negative control only: test-only interception after both load_observations calls return empty, with a witnessed two-process barrier before append; expect duplicate-ID archive rows (RED), otherwise INCONCLUSIVE if witness missing. Post-repair acceptance: remove after-read barrier (a correct lock may serialize it), synchronize only before function entry, require both exit 0, parse every JSONL line, exactly one persisted observation_id, no partial/corrupt lines, and one append result 1 and the other 0. Capture process exit codes, witness and stdout/stderr. Keep P0 output generation, P1 process admission, reader snapshot atomicity, and archive safety distinct.
